concerns.text: T012's calibrator requires `data/raw/golden_dataset.csv` — 'produced by the physical sweep in T005' — but T005 only writes per-run CSVs to `data/raw/` and never creates a file named `golden_dataset.csv`. No task produces the exact artifact T012 depends on, so T012 is unexecutable as written. Either add golden-dataset assembly to T005/T006 (named file, defined columns) or change T012 to consume the aggregated `data/processed/execution_runs.csv`.

T002 consolidates seven previously separate deliverables (discovery, tool verification, CPU profiling, radio metrics, thermal check, tcpdump/mpstat parsing, timing) into one module with one test file. This is too coarse for deterministic execution — flag for the task_atomizer to split into independently verifiable sub-tasks (e.g., discovery/tooling vs. instrumentation parsing).

T003 likewise bundles six deliverables (state tracking, heartbeat/re-assignment, dropout logging, RAM-aware splitting, straggler timeout, saturation abort, benchmark workload) into one scheduler task. Too coarse; should be atomized so each behavior has its own verifiable test.

T004 permits 'a reduced node count is acceptable for this first pass' with no minimum bound and no named follow-up that guarantees the constitutionally-required 10–20 node scale is ever exercised. The verification clause is therefore satisfiable at any scale; state a minimum node count or point to T005 as the full-scale run.
